resources.name: Omron Management
resources.description: Backend API for the Omron weight control system. See backend/AGENTS.md for the architecture and docs/schema.dbml for the data model.

resources.name: Users
resources.description: Composite use cases for User + UserProfile. Two endpoints: register a new user with their profile in a single transaction (POST), and update an existing user and their profile together (PUT). Both run in DB::transaction so the user and profile are created/updated atomically. The register endpoint is admin-only (create policy); the update endpoint follows the standard update policy (self or admin).

resources.name: Register User with Profile
resources.description: POST /api/users/register — composite create. Body: name (string, required), email (string, required, unique), password (string, required, min 8), sex (male|female, required), birth_date (date, required), height_reference_cm (float, optional, 0..300), activity_level (sedentary|light|moderate|active|very_active, optional). Creates the User and the UserProfile in a single transaction. Requires create policy (admin).

resources.name: Update User with Profile
resources.description: PUT /api/users/{user}/with-profile — composite update. All body fields optional (sometimes): name, email (unique excluding self), password (min 8), sex, birth_date, height_reference_cm, activity_level. Updates the User and the UserProfile in a single transaction. If profile fields are provided and the profile doesn't exist, a new profile is created (requires sex and birth_date). If no profile fields are provided, only the user is updated. Path: set `user_id` env var. Soft-deleted returns 404. Requires update policy (self or admin).

resources.name: Anthropometric Measurements
resources.description: CRUD for the AnthropometricMeasurement resource (1:1 with measurement_sessions). All endpoints require auth:sanctum (Bearer token). Authz: viewAny is admin-only; view/update are self (owner of the measurement_session) or admin; delete is self or super-admin; create is any authenticated user (validated against the measurement_session ownership).

resources.name: List Anthropometric Measurements
resources.description: GET /api/anthropometric-measurements — paginated list. Query params: per_page (1..100, default 25), page (>=1), measurement_session_id (exact match). Ordered by created_at DESC. Requires viewAny (admin).

resources.name: Create Anthropometric Measurement
resources.description: POST /api/anthropometric-measurements — body: measurement_session_id (int, required, must exist and not already have an anthropometric_measurement), height_cm (float, required, 0..300), weight_kg (float, required, 0..700), bmi (float, required, 0..99.9). The measurement_session must belong to the actor (or actor is admin).

resources.name: Show Anthropometric Measurement
resources.description: GET /api/anthropometric-measurements/{anthropometric_measurement} — returns the measurement with eager-loaded measurementSession. Path: set `anthropometric_measurement_id` env var. Soft-deleted returns 404. Requires view (self or admin).

resources.name: Update Anthropometric Measurement
resources.description: PUT/PATCH /api/anthropometric-measurements/{anthropometric_measurement} — all fields optional (sometimes). height_cm (0..300), weight_kg (0..700), bmi (0..99.9). Soft-deleted returns 404. Requires update (self or admin).

resources.name: Delete Anthropometric Measurement
resources.description: DELETE /api/anthropometric-measurements/{anthropometric_measurement} — soft delete. Requires delete (self or super-admin).

resources.name: Body Composition Measurements
resources.description: CRUD for the BodyCompositionMeasurement resource (1:1 with measurement_sessions). All endpoints require auth:sanctum. Authz: viewAny is admin-only; view/update are self (owner of the measurement_session) or admin; delete is self or super-admin; create is any authenticated user (validated against the measurement_session ownership).

resources.name: List Body Composition Measurements
resources.description: GET /api/body-composition-measurements — paginated list. Query params: per_page (1..100, default 25), page (>=1), measurement_session_id (exact match). Ordered by created_at DESC. Requires viewAny (admin).

resources.name: Create Body Composition Measurement
resources.description: POST /api/body-composition-measurements — body: measurement_session_id (int, required, must exist and not already have one), body_fat_percentage (float, nullable, 0..99.9), muscle_percentage (float, nullable, 0..99.9), visceral_fat_level (int, nullable, 0..100), metabolic_age (int, nullable, 0..150), bmr_kcal (int, nullable, 0..10000). The measurement_session must belong to the actor (or actor is admin).

resources.name: Show Body Composition Measurement
resources.description: GET /api/body-composition-measurements/{body_composition_measurement} — returns the measurement with eager-loaded measurementSession. Path: set `body_composition_measurement_id` env var. Soft-deleted returns 404. Requires view (self or admin).

resources.name: Update Body Composition Measurement
resources.description: PUT/PATCH /api/body-composition-measurements/{body_composition_measurement} — all fields optional (sometimes). All numeric fields nullable. Soft-deleted returns 404. Requires update (self or admin).

resources.name: Delete Body Composition Measurement
resources.description: DELETE /api/body-composition-measurements/{body_composition_measurement} — soft delete. Requires delete (self or super-admin).

resources.name: Devices
resources.description: CRUD for the Device resource (e.g. Omron scales, user_id is nullable for unassigned devices). All endpoints require auth:sanctum. Authz: viewAny is admin-only; view/update are self (user_id matches) or admin; delete is self or super-admin; create is any authenticated user (validated against user_id ownership).

resources.name: List Devices
resources.description: GET /api/devices — paginated list. Query params: per_page (1..100, default 25), page (>=1), user_id (exact match), brand (ilike %term%). Ordered by created_at DESC. Requires viewAny (admin).

resources.name: Create Device
resources.description: POST /api/devices — body: user_id (int, nullable, must exist if provided), brand (string, required, max 255), model (string, required, max 255), serial_number (string, nullable, max 255). The user_id must match the actor (or actor is admin).

resources.name: Show Device
resources.description: GET /api/devices/{device} — returns the device with eager-loaded user. Path: set `device_id` env var. Soft-deleted returns 404. Requires view (self or admin).

resources.name: Update Device
resources.description: PUT/PATCH /api/devices/{device} — all fields optional (sometimes). Soft-deleted returns 404. Requires update (self or admin).

resources.name: Delete Device
resources.description: DELETE /api/devices/{device} — soft delete. Requires delete (self or super-admin).

resources.name: Goals
resources.description: CRUD for the Goal resource (weight/body fat targets with dates and status). All endpoints require auth:sanctum. Authz: viewAny is admin-only; view/update are self (user_id matches) or admin; delete is self or super-admin; create is any authenticated user (validated against user_id ownership).

resources.name: List Goals
resources.description: GET /api/goals — paginated list. Query params: per_page (1..100, default 25), page (>=1), user_id (exact match), status (active|achieved|abandoned). Ordered by created_at DESC. Requires viewAny (admin).

resources.name: Create Goal
resources.description: POST /api/goals — body: user_id (int, required, must exist), target_weight_kg (float, nullable, 0..700), target_body_fat_percentage (float, nullable, 0..99.9), start_date (date, required), target_date (date, nullable, must be after start_date), status (active|achieved|abandoned, optional, default 'active'). The user_id must match the actor (or actor is admin).

resources.name: Show Goal
resources.description: GET /api/goals/{goal} — returns the goal with eager-loaded user. Path: set `goal_id` env var. Soft-deleted returns 404. Requires view (self or admin).

resources.name: Update Goal
resources.description: PUT/PATCH /api/goals/{goal} — all fields optional (sometimes). Soft-deleted returns 404. Requires update (self or admin).

resources.name: Delete Goal
resources.description: DELETE /api/goals/{goal} — soft delete. Requires delete (self or super-admin).
